products.product_description: Cascade Raw Cheddar GTIN #90854115003059 packed in an approximately 6 lb quarter wheels vacuum sealed. All quarter wheels are variable weight sold by the pound and each vacuum sealed package contains 1 quarter wheel.
products.code_info: Any LOT code ending in 177 with a Sell By date of approximately May 2025. Lot Code: 1106177
products.reason_for_recall: The Cascade Raw Cheddar Cheese was recalled due to Shiga toxin-producing E. coli (STEC) and elevated generic E.coli in finished product testing results.
